item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description: Agents can now ask you to put options in order or to review a list item by item. The question shows numbered rows you reorder, or one verdict per item with a note where needed; your answer goes back to the agent as structured input, never as approval. The Island opens these questions in the main window. Also: one toolbar status chip, a compact Today, and a context panel beside the top decision.
